summary: Archives the report of the joint IETF and ITU-T working team on applying MPLS to transport networks. The team recommended that the two organizations work together, bringing transport requirements into the IETF and extending MPLS forwarding, OAM, survivability, network management, and control plane protocols to meet them. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Two groups were building roads in the same land. This is the report where they agreed to work together on one set of roads instead of two incompatible ones.
